description:
SEC-048 Phase E.3 host-side fixture for `subgroup_host_verify_round_trip` in issuer-registry.

Generated by:
  cd circuits && PATH="$(pwd)/../.toolchain/bin:$PATH" \
    node build/bjj_subgroup_proof_js/generate_witness.js \
         build/bjj_subgroup_proof_js/bjj_subgroup_proof.wasm \
         /tmp/subgroup_input.json /tmp/sg.wtns
  cd circuits/build && snarkjs groth16 prove \
         bjj_subgroup_proof_final.zkey /tmp/sg.wtns \
         /tmp/sg_proof.json /tmp/sg_pub.json
  snarkjs groth16 verify bjj_subgroup_verification_key.json \
         /tmp/sg_pub.json /tmp/sg_proof.json   # -> [INFO] OK!

Input: BabyJubJub Base8 in circomlib-native form (decimal x/y).  This is
NOT a real issuer pubkey -- Base8 is the generator and is in-subgroup
by construction; it's the canonical positive-test vector.

If the subgroup VK rotates, regenerate by re-running the snarkjs
commands above and replacing this file's `proof` + `publicSignals`
fields.  `vk_path` is left unchanged (points at the in-tree pinned
VK file).  The test enforces strict matching against the pinned VK.
